properties.displayName: SCF - Manual Attestation for SOAR Platform Integration
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to ensure the provision of the ability for a SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) platform to consume cloud security alerts and trigger an appropriate workflow. Integrating a SOAR platform enhances incident response capabilities and streamlines security operations.
